entities.name: Johann Carl Megerle von Mühlfeld
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Carl Megerle von Mühlfeld was an Austrian naturalist who served as the first curator of insects at the Imperial Natural History Cabinet in Vienna. He took a special interest in molluscs. The genus Megerlia is named after him.
